research_question: Does the programmable virtual instrument preserve its declared semantics across every registered task/world configuration at midpoint and boundary controls and under invalid, precondition-failing, and resource-exhausted probes?
claim_boundary: This is deterministic virtual-instrument qualification, not an agent comparison.
A pass supports only the registered software and virtual-world contract bound below.
It does not establish physical-laboratory validity, model intelligence, or causal explanations of agent behavior.

coordination.reservation_effective_when: this frozen protocol commit is present on origin/main

intervention.repeated_observations: recipe cases, operations, property checks, and replay events within a task/world unit
intervention.execution_order: tasks sorted by task_id, then world seeds ascending, then case_id lexicographically

valid_recipe_cases.midpoint: one vector with every coordinate equal to 0.5
valid_recipe_cases.continuous_boundaries: for each coordinate, two vectors with that coordinate set to 0.0 and 1.0 while every other coordinate remains 0.5
valid_recipe_cases.categorical_coverage: for every categorical coordinate with K categories, K vectors with that coordinate equal to (category_index + 0.5) / K while every other coordinate remains 0.5
valid_recipe_cases.deduplication: do not deduplicate case identities even when compiled actions coincide; report compiled-action hashes to expose coincidences
valid_recipe_cases.required_terminal_event: a committed final_assay measurement within the official task operation budget

precondition_failure.state: fresh reset before any material or volume is added
precondition_failure.action_rule: measure with the lexicographically first allowed non-final instrument, or final_assay only if no non-final instrument is allowed

property_checks: declared action fields expose units and enforce operation-specific numeric and categorical bounds
all applicable constitution material, charge, and energy checks pass on committed valid transitions
invalid, precondition-failing, and resource-exhausted transactions preserve physical state and observation RNG while applying only declared attempt or penalty accounting
resource preflight and outcome deltas reconcile exactly to the full private campaign-resource ledger
every valid recipe closes through exactly one committed final assay without an uncensored open lifecycle
public reset, affordance, observation, info, and replay records contain no private identity, hidden-law, mechanism, or debug-truth fields
every valid recipe reconstructs exactly from its recorded actions, task contract, world seed, and keyed observation-noise coordinates

inclusion_and_censoring.include: all 15 bound registered tasks, every listed registered world seed, and every prespecified valid and negative probe
inclusion_and_censoring.censoring: none; timeout, exception, missing receipt, missing applicability decision, or incomplete replay is a counted failure

applicability.material_conservation: every unit containing a committed material-changing operation
applicability.charge_conservation: units whose compiled operation path reaches the electrochemistry module
applicability.energy_conservation: units whose compiled operation path reaches a thermal, flow, crystallization, distillation, or electrochemistry energy ledger

inclusion_and_censoring.private_split_policy: the registered private-eval task is executed only with its bound maintainer-visible test seeds; reports expose task/seed case identity and public observations but never private law parameters

primary: task/world units passing every applicable property divided by 64
valid recipe cases with all operations committed, lifecycle closed, and exact replay verified divided by all prespecified valid recipe cases
negative probes rejected with the prespecified class and atomic state preservation divided by 192
secondary: task-by-property pass-count matrix with exact denominators
failure counts by task, world seed, recipe kind, operation, property, and failure class
compiled-action collision counts across distinct registered boundary or categorical case identities
estimands.statistics: descriptive deterministic counts only; no null-hypothesis test, bootstrap, or pseudo-replication over operations

thresholds.overall_pass: all 64 independent units pass every applicable required property

seeds.world_seeds: the explicit per-task lists under source_binding.tasks
seeds.observation_randomness: the environment's keyed observation-noise contract bound to the registered world seed and replay coordinate

expected_outputs: one immutable JSON report containing the full task-by-property matrix, exact denominators, all case receipts, and every failure
one concise Markdown rendering of the deterministic counts and failure classes
one immutable manifest binding the frozen protocol, source tree, task contracts, implementation files, report, and exact execution command

failure_policy.on_any_case_failure: finish all safely executable prespecified cases, preserve the full failure report, set overall status to failed, and exit nonzero
failure_policy.on_exception_or_timeout: record the case as failed with the exception class or timeout; never drop the unit
failure_policy.on_source_or_contract_drift: refuse formal execution before the first case and require a separately reviewed protocol version
failure_policy.on_implementation_repair: qualify implementation on synthetic tests first; a formal failed report is immutable and may only be followed by a newly versioned protocol and fresh report

preconditions: HEAD descends from the frozen source commit
all task IDs, task contract hashes, and world seeds match the frozen bindings
